releaseNotes: v1.5.50: Student delight & safety automation update featuring Birthday celebrations, 1-tap Wi-Fi copy, course exam countdown timer, 1-tap seat protection renewals, quiet desk reception alerts, and 10-second front desk billing.

organization.name: The Cozy Corner Study Centre
organization.address: Front Of Reliance Fashion Factory, Nath Road, Parli-431515

studentFeatures.title: Birthday Celebration & 1-Tap Wi-Fi Copy
studentFeatures.description: Celebrate your special day with cozy greetings and copy the high-speed library Wi-Fi password with a single tap directly from your dashboard.

studentFeatures.title: Exam Countdown Widget for Your Course
studentFeatures.description: Stay locked in on your academic dreams with a live daily countdown timer dynamically tailored to your course (UPSC, MPSC, NEET, JEE, GATE, Banking, etc.).

studentFeatures.title: Guaranteed Seat Hold & 1-Tap Renewal
studentFeatures.description: Never lose your favorite desk. Active students get an exclusive seat reservation hold badge and a streamlined 1-tap renewal flow to lock in their seat effortlessly.

studentFeatures.title: Silent Reception & Noise Help Button
studentFeatures.description: Study in complete peace. Discreetly alert reception about noise, AC temperature, Wi-Fi issues, or desk hygiene without leaving your seat or causing a disturbance.

studentFeatures.title: Multi-Notice Carousel & Dedicated Notice Board
studentFeatures.description: Browse library announcements in a swipeable dashboard carousel with instant dismiss and view full historical circulars in the new Notice Board & Circulars hub.

adminFeatures.title: Live Quiet Desk Assistance Stream
adminFeatures.description: Real-time alert banner on the admin console alerting front desk staff immediately with student desk numbers when quiet assistance or noise help is requested.

adminFeatures.title: 10-Second Express Counter Billing & Atomic Seat Parity
adminFeatures.description: Lightning-fast cash payment recording with instant receipts and zero-drift concurrency safety ensuring double-allocations are impossible.

adminFeatures.title: Resilient Multi-Key Receipt Retrieval
adminFeatures.description: Multi-field indexing ensures every student fee receipt is immediately visible in student and admin histories across student IDs, auth UIDs, and mobile numbers.

adminFeatures.title: Categorized Quick Action Studio & Instant Petty Cash
adminFeatures.description: Upgraded the bottom (+) button into a high-speed Quick Action Studio grouped into Daily Transactions and Admissions/Notices with petty cash expense logging.
